registered_after: Observed OHLC-proxy outcomes and top-winner execution mismatches; this is a model correction, not a fresh holdout.
entry: At scheduled next 5m opening strictly after signal availability and before expiry, request latest historical SIP quote at or BEFORE that exact timestamp. No trade-bar open is used for entry.
quote_validity: Latest quote within prior 60 seconds; regular R condition; finite positive bid<=ask, ask size positive; ask<=250 USD for supported 100-share round-lot assumption. No future quote, crossed/nonregular/unknown/stale quote, or missing quote may fill.
size: Fill min(reserved whole-share quantity, displayed ask round lots*100); cancel remainder immediately. Do not assume hidden liquidity or refreshing depth.
price: Ask*(1+adverse_bps/10000) must be <= intent limit and > protective stop. A quote below protection cancels entry BEFORE submitting modeled buy. No alternate quote or favorable future tick is selected.
signal_expiry: Unchanged MLP2: 5 minutes from modeled signal availability; no same-session reentry expansion.
quote_capture: GET /v2/stocks/quotes, symbols=one, feed=sip, asof=2025-04-25, start=open-60s,end=open inclusive,sort=desc,limit=1; cache/retry/rate-limit; only pending orders request quotes; cache seals recorded.
management: Unchanged existing regular 5m stop-first/partial proxy, prior-daily EMA exit, mechanical actions, shared account. Thus exit execution remains unverified against quote/depth; gaps retain primary HALT and secondary OBSERVED_ONLY semantics.
no_ex_post_trade_deletion: Rerun entire shared account with quote entry rules, including sizing, cash freed by partial entries, holdings, later signals and exits. Never subtract a few winning trades from the old result.
